4. Arrange the allotropes in their order of their importance.
(i) Extraction of yellow phosphorus
(ii) Preparation of artificial diamond
(iii) Gas masks
(iv) Moderator in nuclear reactors
(v) Abrasive for cutting glass
(A) Wood charcoal (B) Bone charcoal
(C) Graphite (D) Diamond
(E) Sugar charcoal
(a) CDEBA (b) BEACD
(c) CAEDB (d) BCAED

5. The descriptions of some reactions are given below. Arrange th
products of the reactions in the order of the descriptions.
(i) Passing carbon monoxide gas over finely divided iron
(ii) Passing carbon dioxide through powdered magnesium
(iii) Heating metal oxide ($\mathrm{M}_2\mathrm{O}_3$) with carbon monoxide
(iv) Passing carbon dioxide through sodium
(A) $\mathrm{M}_2\mathrm{CO}_3$ (B) M
(C) MO (D) $\mathrm{M}(\mathrm{CO})_5$
(a) CABD (b) DACB
(c) DCBA (d) CBDA

6. Which of the following reactions does not produce $\mathrm{CO}_2$?
(a) Heating of $\mathrm{Na_2CO_3}$ (b) Reaction of $\mathrm{K_2CO_3}$ with HCl
(c) Heating of $\mathrm{Ca}(\mathrm{HCO}_3)_2$ (d) Heating of $\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$

7. Identify the principle invovled in the usage of baking powder in cakes.
(a) Acid base neutralization
(b) Thermal decomposition
(c) Dissolution in water
(d) Sublimation

8. Which of the following fire extinguishers, when used, involves a physical
process instead of a chemical reaction?
(a) Dry powder extinguisher
(b) Foam-type extinguisher
(c) Soda-acid extinguisher
(d) Liquid $\text{CO}_2$ fire extinguisher

9. Graphite is used for various purposes. Which of the following uses is not
related to its layer lattice structure?
(a) Refractory crucible (b) Pencil lead
(c) Lubricant (d) Both (b) and (c)
